timing_note: Excludes discarded work in an interrupted partial epoch when resuming.
checkpoint_selection: Highest validation mAP50-95 (Ultralytics 8.4.173 default fitness). Ties keep the latest checkpoint.
precision_recall_note: Ultralytics detection P/R at its validation F1 operating point, not the future business threshold.

confusion_matrix.rows: predicted class; last row = background/missed object
confusion_matrix.columns: true class; last column = background/unmatched prediction
confusion_matrix.settings_note: Ultralytics ConfusionMatrix.process_batch defaults; differs from AP matching thresholds.

limitations: Three confirmed related train-validation pairs; leave supplied splits unchanged and acknowledge possible validation optimism.
One validation and one test photo contain vehicles but have empty labels; do not relabel.
Photo backgrounds, views and image quality differ between classes and may differ from rental inspection photos.
A photo does not establish an accident, its timing, fault, hidden mechanical damage or roadworthiness.
No matches in a pHash screen do not prove full source independence.
